proposed.text: Before a machine-graded lumber piece is used, which marking information does NSCP Section 622.6 say should be inspected?

options.text: Mill, certifying organization, timber size, stress grade, and moisture content.
Paint color, retail price, and delivery receipt number only.
Only the common species name, with no stress grade or moisture mark.

rationale.correct: Section 622.6 states that each machine-graded lumber piece should be inspected for a mark containing the mill, certifying organization, timber size, stress grade, and moisture content.
rationale.a: Not selected: This is the checked Section 622.6 marking set.
rationale.b: Not selected: those items are not the source-supported marking requirements.
rationale.c: Not selected: the checked source requires more than species name.
rationale.d: Not selected: contractor approval alone is not the checked marking set.
rationale.takeaway: Machine-graded lumber requires field-verifiable grading and moisture information.
